units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 7:1:9">Y. Gitt. VII, 48ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>נשתתק מתוך בּוֹרְיוֹ</he> lost his speech while in his normal health (suddenly), opp. <he>מתון חוליו</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 1:3:7">Y. Nidd. I, 49ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:6:4">Y. Keth. V, 30ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>פירש מתוך</he> (<he>בָּרְיוֹ</he>) <he>בוריו</he> the child ceased to suck while in normal health. Mekh. Mishp. N’zikin. 6; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 4:4:6">Y. Keth. IV, 28ᶜ</cite> top (expl. <he>על משענתו</he> <cite ref="Exodus 21:19">Ex. XXI, 19</cite> ‘on his own support’) <he>על בוריו</he> restored to his former health. Mekh. l. c. 13 <he>על בריו</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:4:2">Y. Sot. I, 16ᵈ</cite> <he>עמדי על בורייך</he> stand by thy assertion (be not intimidated).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 70:14">Gen. R. s. 70</cite> <he>מעמידין אותו על בוריו</he> they establish it (the law) on its strength, i.e. arrive at a final decision.
